📅 2023-12-16 Shelling / Artillery — Direct hit — Overwhelmed (capacity crisis) INC-323
Building damaged becoming minimally operational

Occupation forces fired artillery at hospital during its ground incursion into al-Daraj neighborhood. The next day The WHO announced that three hospitals remained minimally operational in the northern Gaza Strip, including Al-Sahaba Medical Complex and Al-Ahli Hospital, which are partially operational.
